# Medical Bill Reader

> A direct-to-consumer service with a local-only bill-and-EOB worksheet and an optional AI-assisted explainer for supported redacted documents. It organizes user-entered or legible visible information into plain-language sections and questions to verify. It is not a certified audit or medical, legal, insurance, coding, or financial advice.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-23

## Main tool

- [Private Bill and EOB Comparison Worksheet](https://medicalbillreader.com/bill-eob-comparison-worksheet): A free, local-only worksheet for amounts the visitor enters. Values stay in current browser memory and are not uploaded or saved between visits.
- [Medical Bill Analyzer](https://medicalbillreader.com/#analyzer): One free analysis per browser per UTC calendar month (subject to network abuse controls), or one additional analysis for $4.99. No new monthly subscriptions are sold.
- A one-time bill-and-EOB comparison is planned at $9.99 but is not available for purchase. The public comparison checkout remains disabled pending quality, payment, privacy, and owner-approval gates.
- Existing monthly subscribers retain server-verified access and a Stripe-hosted manage-or-cancel path while retirement is reviewed.
- The tool may organize visible codes, charges, adjustments, plan payments, and patient-responsibility fields.
- It cannot determine fraud, upcoding, unbundling, medical necessity, coverage, legal compliance, or whether a charge is correct from a bill alone.

## Privacy and processing

- Remove unnecessary names, addresses, member IDs, account numbers, barcodes, and other identifiers before uploading.
- The application forwards the supported document to Anthropic only after an affirmative processing acknowledgement.
- Medical Bill Reader does not intentionally persist the bill or report in its own database or send upload, analysis, report, or payment events to advertising or analytics systems.
- Anthropic's published standard commercial API policy states that inputs and outputs are automatically deleted within 30 days. Anthropic says policy-flagged inputs and outputs may be retained for up to two years and associated trust-and-safety classification scores for up to seven years; legal and other published exceptions may also apply. Medical Bill Reader does not claim zero-data-retention or HIPAA/BAA coverage.
- [Consumer Health Data Privacy Notice](https://medicalbillreader.com/consumer-health-data-privacy)
- [Privacy Policy](https://medicalbillreader.com/privacy)
- [Cookie Policy](https://medicalbillreader.com/cookies)

## Source-backed guides

- [Questions to Ask About a Medical Bill](https://medicalbillreader.com/questions-to-ask-about-medical-bill): A privacy-conscious provider and health-plan checklist based on current CMS and IRS sources.
- [Synthetic Sample Medical Bill and EOB Report](https://medicalbillreader.com/sample-medical-bill-report): A fully fabricated, no-upload walkthrough of common bill and EOB fields, amount relationships, and questions to verify.

## Current advertising status

No advertising code currently loads on the site. Any future ads require account and consent readiness and are restricted to nonsensitive editorial or marketing pages, never the analyzer, upload, results, pricing, checkout, or privacy-request experience.
